comparisons.peer_topic: Goodwill impairment triggers and recent results
comparisons.peer_summary: Changes in operating plans, business conditions, or macroeconomic environment could reduce cash flow estimates and trigger future goodwill impairment charges; however, the annual qualitative test concluded it is not more likely than not that carrying value exceeded fair value for any reporting unit.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AMD disclose that they performed a qualitative impairment test in the current fiscal year and concluded that no impairment indicators existed or that fair value exceeded carrying value for their reporting units. MU specifically noted the absence of impairment indicators after a 2023 charge, while AMD concluded it was 'not more likely than not that the carrying value of each reporting unit exceeded its fair value' based on its annual qualitative test.

sentences.text: We performed a qualitative assessment for the current year and have not identified any impairment indicators for our reporting units.
Based on our annual qualitative impairment test, we concluded it is not more likely than not that the carrying value of each reporting unit exceeded its fair value.

comparisons.peer_summary: Goodwill impairment is assessed annually or when indicators exist using a qualitative first step; factors considered include adverse economic trends, company-specific actions, financial performance deterioration, or sustained market capitalization decreases below net book value.
comparisons.comparison: Similar to MU, AVGO describes a qualitative assessment process to determine if it is 'more likely than not that the fair value of any of our reporting units is less than its carrying amount.' Both companies use this qualitative step to decide whether further quantitative testing is required, although AVGO explicitly lists factors like macroeconomic trends while MU simply states no indicators were found.

sentences.text: Goodwill: We test goodwill for impairment in our fourth quarter each year, or more frequently if indicators of an impairment exist, to determine whether it is more likely than not that the fair value of the reporting unit with goodwill is less than its carrying value.
